**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity), §6(a) [p0032].**

- **Issue:** The term is evergreen (§2 — runs until terminated under §6), but the only convenience right is exercisable "at any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding." So Clear Capital has no exit from any live SOW — effectively no Customer convenience right, which falls below the fallback (60–90 days' notice with an ETF capped at 3 months' fees).
- **Secondary point:** The same sentence gives RadialSpark an at-will exit on 15 days' notice (fallback allows Vendor convenience only end-of-term on 90 days), mitigated only by the no-outstanding-SOW limitation.
- **Redline (validated, preferred position):** adds a 30-day Company convenience right over the Agreement or any SOW, payment only for Services performed plus refund of prepaid fees, no penalty or accelerated payment; conforms Contractor's residual at-will right to 90 days' notice between engagements.
